riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine warmth with boundaries. They empathize with patient distress while maintaining professional judgment under pressure.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most moving part of this work is its long-term commitment. Psychiatric treatment often lasts months or years. You can support a patient from an acute episode into stability and watch that person return to work and daily life, creating a distinctive sense of having held someone through a crisis.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Investigative I + Artistic A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「有温度又有边界」的人——既能共情患者的痛苦，也能在高压下保持专业判断。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最动人之处是「长期主义」：精神疾病治疗是以月甚至年为单位的，你可能陪一个患者从急性期走到稳定期、看着他重新回到工作生活里，这种「接住一个人」的成就感是别的岗位给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 研究型 I + 艺术型 A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who are psychologically resilient, logical, and committed to procedure. They can work around death and grief without changing conclusions under pressure.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work is not a glamorous role for everyone; it demands an exceptional sense of responsibility. Every case affects a family, and each conclusion must withstand review. People who remain calm amid pressure and grief and establish the facts can develop a strong professional identity here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「心理硬、逻辑稳、守程序」的人——你能跟死亡和悲伤打交道，也能在结论面前不改口。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行不是适合所有人的「酷」，而是一种极端的责任感：每一个案件背后都是一个家庭，你的结论要经得起复核。能在高压和悲伤里保持冷静、把事实查清楚的人，会在这里找到很强的职业认同。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 现实型 R + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who work quickly, tolerate hard work, and can handle repetition. Performing simple tasks consistently is the first step toward earning trust across the kitchen.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The work is not glamorous, but it is tangible: every plate you wash is used by the next guest. Peak-hour pressure drives the pace, and food-service teams remember people who stay composed and complete the work efficiently.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Enterprising (E)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手脚快、能吃苦、又耐得住重复」的人——把简单的事做稳，是后厨所有岗位信任你的第一步。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行没什么浪漫可言，但踏实：你洗的每一只盘子，都是下一位客人要用的。高峰期的节奏会推着你走，但能撑住那种节奏、把活干利索的人，在餐饮圈里是被人记着好的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 企业型 E

breadcrumb.label: Education And Childcare Administrators, Preschool And Daycare

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who enjoy children and are willing to carry responsibility for an entire center. Watching children become comfortable and seeing parental trust grow creates a sense of stewardship that conventional office management cannot provide.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most meaningful part is watching children grow. From crying for a parent on the first day to performing confidently at graduation, directors contribute to the early years of many families. Parental trust and a strong center reputation create a serious but deeply grounded sense of responsibility.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 学前教育与托育机构管理者

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「喜欢孩子，又愿意扛一园子责任」的人——看着自己园里的孩子从哭闹到开怀，家长的信任一天天攒起来，这份被托付的感觉，是办公室管理岗给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有温度的是「看着孩子长大」：从刚入园哭着找妈妈，到毕业时能大方表演，你参与的是几百个家庭的头几年；家长信任你，园子口碑起来，这种被人托付的感觉很重也很踏实。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Fire prevention and protection engineering is worth considering if you stay curious about the field and accept judgment under moderate risk.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field turns engineering into safety. Calculations must be accurate, and codes allow no shortcuts. It suits rigorous, responsible, patient people.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research and analysis, hands-on implementation, and clear standards (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Fire Prevention And Protection Engineers有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，工程师值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「用工程换平安」——既要算得准，也要对规范零容忍。适合严谨、有责任感、不浮躁的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究分析、动手实现、也重规范（研究 I + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of All Other Tactical Operations Specialists

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This role suits people who treat the team as home and accept responsibility. Watching people you trained become independent operators can feel more meaningful than any performance bonus.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The strongest reward is knowing that you built the team. When a team member has a problem during training, you take responsibility first. When a mission succeeds, the team receives the credit. Long service builds deep trust among teammates, a form of leadership value few other roles provide.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Enterprising E + Social S

breadcrumb.label: 一线主管（其他战术行动专业人员）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「以队为家、能扛事」的人——看着自己带出来的兵一个个独当一面，这种成就感比任何绩效奖金都实在。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最让人踏实的是「队伍是你带的」：训练场上队员出了问题你第一个扛，任务完成得好功劳归集体。干久了会形成一种很强的兄弟信任，这种带队伍的价值感是别的岗位给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 企业型 E + 社会型 S

breadcrumb.label: First Line Supervisors Of Landscaping, Lawn Service, And Groundskeeping Workers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career offers visible delivery: bare ground becomes green space and uneven growth becomes an attractive landscape. Client acceptance can make the outdoor effort feel worthwhile.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work offers visible results. Under your direction, an overgrown site becomes an even lawn and hedge, and the client approves the finished project. Combining teams and sites into a successful delivery provides tangible satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Enterprising E + Social S + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 园林绿化工人一线主管

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行最直接的是「看得见的交付」：从荒地到绿地，从参差不齐到齐整漂亮，客户验收点头的那一刻，你会觉得晒黑的皮肤都值了。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最踏实的是「干完就看得见成果」：一片荒草地在你的调度下变成齐整的草坪和绿篱，客户验收时点头，那种把团队和现场捏合到一块的成就感很实在。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 企业型 E + 社会型 S + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who see helping others make informed decisions as a mission. Their expertise supports families during life-changing moments.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The reward comes from using expertise to support emotion. Clear information about prevention or intervention can change how a family faces a difficult result.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Social S + Artistic A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「帮助别人做决定」当使命的人——你的专业，是别人人生最艰难时刻的一根拐杖。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最动人的地方在于「用专业接住情绪」：当你告诉一个家庭「这个病可以干预、可以预防」时，他们眼里的光，是这份工作最直接的回报。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 社会型 S + 艺术型 A

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: The career suits people who can handle field conditions and then focus quietly on mapping. They interpret subsurface evidence and communicate it through drawings.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this work is making the unseen visible. A vein or fold can look like ordinary rock to others but reveal immense geological history to a technician. People who enjoy fieldwork, tolerate solitude, and like turning data into maps can find a strong sense of exploration.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 地质技术员（不含水文技术员）

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「耐得住野外、又静得下心画图」的人——把地下的秘密读出来，再用图纸告诉世界。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的魅力在于「把看不见的变成看得见的」：一条岩脉、一层褶皱，外人眼里是石头，你眼里是亿万年的地质史。喜欢野外、耐得住寂寞、又享受数据成图的人，会在这里找到探索感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 实际型 R + 事务型 C

breadcrumb.label: Laborers And Freight, Stock, And Material Movers, Hand

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who want straightforward work based on physical effort: do the work, get paid, earn more in peak season, and leave the job behind after the shift.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field is practical rather than glamorous: piece-rate work rewards output, peak-season overtime can pay well, there is no office routine or heavy mental load, and work ends when the shift ends. For many people who want steady income based on physical effort, that makes it a good fit.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 劳工与货运、物料搬运工、手工

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「凭力气吃饭、图个简单直接」的人——不玩虚的，干活给钱，旺季收入可观，下班就下班。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行不谈情怀，谈实在：计件多劳多得，旺季加班费可观，不坐办公室、不费脑子，下班就下班。对很多只想凭力气挣份稳定收入的人来说，这就是好工作。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine practicality, attention to detail, and patience. Devices must be precise and considerate, balancing craftsmanship with fitting and remaining willing to revise.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops care through materials. Technicians must understand craftsmanship and anatomy and patiently create devices that fit. It suits practical, meticulous people willing to take responsibility for others who value the reassuring moment when a fitting works.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, investigative, and helpful work (Realistic R + Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 细致 + 有耐心」凑一块的人——器具要做得准也要做得暖，工艺和试穿要平衡也要敢改。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「材料里的体贴」——既要懂工艺与解剖，也要有把器具做得合身的耐心。适合务实、细致、又愿意对人负责的人，也享受「试穿合上」的踏实。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、探究、也助人（企业 R + 研究 I + 社会 S）。

breadcrumb.label: Occupational Health And Safety Specialists And Technicians

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who see hazards and hold a firm safety baseline. You protect not reports but every worker's ability to return home safely after work.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most meaningful moment is when an accident does not happen. A hazard you insisted on correcting truly prevents an accident half a year later. No one thanks you directly, but you know your persistence mattered.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 职业健康与安全专员及技术员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「眼里有隐患、心里有底线」的人——你守护的不是报表，是每个下班能平安回家的人。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有分量的时刻是「事故没发生」：你坚持要求整改的那处隐患，半年后真的避免了一次事故——虽然没人当面感谢你，但你知道自己的坚持值了。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 实际型 R + 事务型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine deep investigation + clear expression + intellectual rigor. Genuine student thinking matters above all.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The hardest and most rewarding part is the moment of insight. When a student suddenly learns to view the news through an institutional lens, the moment repays all the preparation. It suits people who can sit with literature, stand confidently at the lectern, and insist that students truly learn to think.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers investigation, practical work, and helping others (Investigative I + Realistic R + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「钻研深 + 表达清 + 较真」凑一块的人——学生真会想比啥都重要。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最磨人也最爽的是「开窍」——一个学生突然会用制度视角看新闻，那一下值回所有备课。适合坐得住文献、又能站得住讲台、愿意为「学生真会想」较真的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研、实用、也愿意帮人（研究 I + 实用 R + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine inquiry, communication, and patience. Knowledge must be deep yet clearly explained, while research and education must be carried together.
riasec_fit_block.interest: What this career develops most is the ability to explain complexity simply. Teachers must understand the frontier of their discipline, help students understand it, and sustain research. It suits people who love inquiry and sharing, and who enjoy the entire process from lesson preparation to student achievement.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers inquiry and helping work (Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「钻研 + 表达 + 耐心」凑一块的人——知识要深也要讲得清，研究与育人要同时扛。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把复杂讲简单」——既要懂本学科前沿，也要把学生教明白、把研究做下去。适合爱钻研、也愿意分享的人，享受从备课到学生出成果的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好钻研、助人（研究 I + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people with steady hands, accurate eyes, and the patience to stay with the line. Print finishing is all about details; protect those details and the finished product withstands scrutiny.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction of this career comes when you touch the finished product: blank sheets enter and neatly stacked books or boxes emerge, with clean edges, flat spines, and bubble-free lamination. Printing is a traditional industry, but the craftsmanship of finishing workers shows in the feel of every delivered order.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic (R) + Conventional (C) + Investigative (I)

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手稳、眼准、又守得住产线」的人——印刷品后道全是细节，你把细节守住了，成品就经得起看。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感在于「摸到成品那一下」：一批白纸进去，出来是码得整整齐齐的书或盒，切边齐、书脊平、覆膜无气泡。印刷是传统行业，但每一单交付的质感，都看得出后道工人手上的讲究。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 常规型 C + 研究型 I

breadcrumb.label: Radio, Cellular, And Tower Equipment Installers And Repairers

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine comfort with heights + circuit knowledge + safety discipline. The signal should be full, and the technician should descend safely.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops courage with precision. You must be willing to climb, understand RF circuits, and follow safety rules. It suits hands-on people who are comfortable with heights and patient enough to analyze signals.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on work, investigation, and rules (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「不怕高 + 懂电路 + 守安全」凑一块的人——信号要满格，人也要平安下塔。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「胆大心细」——既要敢爬高、懂射频电路，也要守安全规矩；适合爱动手、不怕高、又能坐得住查信号的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、钻研、也规矩（实际 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about taxi driving and are comfortable making judgments under moderate risk, this career is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to hold an entire city in your head. You must know the roads and congestion patterns, tolerate long periods of sitting and irregular schedules, and interact with every kind of passenger. It suits people with a good sense of direction, a calm temperament, and comfort working alone.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic, Enterprising, and Conventional preferences (Realistic R + Enterprising E + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Taxi Drivers有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，出租车司机值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把城市装在脑子里」——既要认得路也懂哪会儿堵，也要耐得住久坐与作息乱，还得和形形色色的乘客打交道。适合方向感好、脾气温、能独处的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好实操、主导、也秩序（现实 R + 企业 E + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Taxi Drivers, Shuttle Drivers, And Chauffeurs

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who can earn a living behind the wheel and still enjoy it. They tolerate solitary driving and engage in passenger conversation.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The freedom in this work comes from holding the steering wheel. You decide whether to work the airport or commercial districts today, meet all kinds of people, and see your earnings the same day. It suits people who dislike fixed office schedules and tolerate long driving hours.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Enterprising E + Artistic A

breadcrumb.label: 出租车、接驳车司机与专职司机

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「方向盘上讨生活也能自得其乐」的人——耐得住孤独驾驶，也接得住乘客的闲聊。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的自在在于「方向盘在自己手里」——今天跑机场还是跑商圈自己说了算，能遇上形形色色的人，收入当天就能见分晓。适合不喜欢坐班、耐得住长时间驾驶的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 企业型 E + 艺术型 A
